A PURPOSE THAT'S PERSONAL

What is the Roll Bed Bath?+

A tub designed to help caregivers bathe people who cannot easily leave their beds. Contact us to discuss suitability for your needs.

How do I purchase the product?+

The listed product price is $600. Contact us by phone or email to confirm availability, shipping, what is included, and ordering arrangements.

Do you offer in-home care?+

Our founder provides non-medical private caregiving through Brunt Home Health LLC. Call to discuss the support you need and current service availability.

Will it work with my bed and water connection?+

Compatibility depends on your setup. Please confirm bed dimensions, water connections, hose length, drainage, and caregiver assistance with us before purchasing.

Where are you based?+

We are based in Winston Salem, North Carolina. Please contact us to confirm in-home care coverage and product shipping options for your location.
